newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ushers of Trowbridge plans stock market float.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ushers of Trowbridge plans stock market float.

text.p: Brewing and pubs group Ushers of Trowbridge Plc said on Monday it plans to list on the London Stock Exchange via a placing.
The float is expected to value the group at between 100.0 and 130.0 million stg and is expected this spring, a spokesman for the company said.
Ushers, with a brewery in Trowbridge and 542 pubs in south and south west England and south Wales, said it expected to issue its pathfinder prospectus in February.
The float will be sponsored by Hambros Bank with Panmure Gordon acting as broker. The listing will allow the group to reduce borrowings and finance expansion, the company said.
Ushers' pretax profit in the year ended 31 October 1996 was 8.6 million stg on turnover of 65.4 million stg.
